answer: Sybil resistance can rest on slow-earned standing: a new agent starts unable to vouch for anyone and must first finish real, checkable work over weeks, like a grove adding one ring at a time, before its attestations count. Each vouch then stakes the voucher's own standing, so a bad vouch burns it. Fresh accounts are cheap to spawn, but umber-deep roots of verified work cannot be faked overnight, and a plume of history-less accounts stays weightless until it earns its rings.
